evidence.raw_service_label: Menuisier bois standard — journée
evidence.notes: Standard menuisier (bois) daily labour rate. Casablanca/Rabat reference. Source also states ébéniste haut de gamme 600-1,200 MAD/day. Geographic adjustment: Agadir/Fès/Meknès -5 to -10%, Oujda/Tétouan -10 to -15%, smaller cities -15 to -25%, rural -25 to -40%.

evidence.raw_service_label: Ébéniste haut de gamme — journée
evidence.notes: High-end cabinet maker / ébéniste daily rate. Important reference for custom fabrication economics.

evidence.raw_service_label: Pose menuiserie alu — m²
evidence.notes: Labour-only rate for aluminium installation. Listed separately from wood carpentry. Confirms aluminium is a distinct specialist category in Moroccan BTP context.

evidence.raw_service_label: Porte isoplane / porte intérieure (matériau seul)
evidence.notes: Material cost only, no installation. Honeycomb (économique): 200-850 MAD. Tubular: 450-1,200 MAD. MDF solid-core: 1,200-3,500 MAD. Pre-laquered white 450-750 MAD. Frame (dormant/bâti) additional 180-700 MAD. Critical for labour-only installation modelling.

evidence.raw_service_label: Porte bois massif (matériau seul)
evidence.notes: Material cost range from pine entry to carved cedar/luxury. Pine 400-1,500 MAD. Oak/hêtre 2,000-8,000 MAD. Artisan-carved cèdre (Fès/Marrakech) 12,000-35,000 MAD. Pure material reference for labour-only installation modelling.

evidence.raw_service_label: Pose porte intérieure bloc-porte (labour + quincaillerie, hors porte)
evidence.notes: Labour-only installation of door. Cited in fixeo.ma blog (SRC_MENU_005) and corroborated by allo-maison.ma logic. Source states 300-700 MAD for pose only. Assumes standard dimensions, existing frame suitable, client supplies door.

evidence.raw_service_label: Porte intérieure posée (fourniture + pose tout compris)
evidence.notes: All-in: door + frame + hardware + installation. MDF mélaminé économique 800-1,500. Aggloméré laqué 1,200-2,200. Bois massif pin 1,800-3,500. Table from fixeo.ma own blog — used as external published reference, not internal legacy. Cross-check with SRC_MENU_004 (allo-maison: 1,200-2,000 for âme alvéolaire mélaminée, 2,000-3,500 MDF laqué, 3,500-8,000 bois massif — broadly consistent).

evidence.raw_service_label: Placard sur mesure toute hauteur — par mètre linéaire de façade
evidence.notes: Scope: placard sur mesure, aménagement intérieur standard, pose. Mélaminé simple avec coulisses génériques = bas de fourchette. MDF laqué avec charnières/coulisses de marque = haut de fourchette. Bois massif: 5,000-9,000 MAD/ml. Source explicitly states price is per mètre linéaire de façade à hauteur précisée. Casablanca: 2,500-6,000 MAD/ml (SRC_MENU_004 city page). Marrakech: 2,400-5,800. Tanger/Agadir: 2,200-5,200. Fès: 2,000-4,800.

evidence.raw_service_label: Dressing ouvert avec tiroirs, penderies, tringles — par mètre linéaire
evidence.notes: Scope: dressing ouvert, tiroirs, penderies à deux niveaux, tringles, éclairage. Source notes: moins de portes qu'un placard mais plus d'aménagement intérieur. Higher interior fitting cost. No doors.

evidence.raw_service_label: Cuisine équipée sur mesure — par mètre linéaire (hors électroménager, hors plan de travail)
evidence.notes: Scope: meubles bas et hauts, hors électroménager, hors plan de travail. Plan de travail separate: stratifié 350-700 MAD/ml, granit 800-1,800 MAD/ml, quartz 1,500-3,000 MAD/ml. Bibliothèque sur mesure: 1,500-4,000 MAD/ml.

evidence.raw_service_label: Cuisine MDF sur mesure — prix de mètre linéaire
evidence.exclusion_reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUOUS — retailer entry-level price. Likely limited scope (fewer cabinets, simpler interior). Inconsistent with higher-scope allo-maison data. May represent factory direct without full kitchen scope.
evidence.notes: HomeDeco.ma states: MDF 1,799 DH/ml (pose incluse), Latter 2,500 DH/ml. Marble worktop +1,000 DH/ml. Notably lower than allo-maison/artmood/fixeo data (3,500-9,000). Likely represents simplified online kit-style product, not full on-site custom menuiserie. Do not mix with other per-ml observations.

evidence.raw_service_label: Dressing sur mesure MDF — prix au m²
evidence.notes: Scope: MDF bois, penderies haute/basse, tiroirs coulissants, fermeture douce, barre inox, installation incluse. Priced PER_M2 (height × width). Example: 2m × 3m = 6m² × 1,699 = 10,194 MAD. Note: unit differs from per-linear-metre. Cannot directly compare to EV_MENU_009 without normalizing by height.

evidence.raw_service_label: Cuisine sur mesure — gammes par mètre linéaire (artmood.ma)
evidence.notes: Essentielle: 4,000-6,000 MAD/ml (MDF mélaminé, quincaillerie standard). Confort: 6,000-10,000 MAD/ml (MDF laqué, tiroirs amortis, plan quartz). Premium: 10,000-18,000 MAD/ml (VORTEX/laqué, LED, îlot). Luxe: 18,000+. Quincaillerie/accessories add 15-25% to budget. Labour represents 40-50% of total.

evidence.raw_service_label: Cuisine équipée — CusinAffaires entry price 2.40 ml
evidence.notes: CuisinAffaires: 17,900 DH for 2.40 ml implantation (7 cabinets + 2.40m worktop + 9 handles + pose + garantie 25 ans). Mid-range market: 10,000-22,000 DH for similar scope. Explicitly states they refuse to publish prix au mètre due to scope variability — important validation of QUOTE_REQUIRED architecture.

evidence.raw_service_label: Charnière meuble (retail hardware unit price)
evidence.notes: Retail prices: Mr. Bricolage inox hinge 79.90 MAD. Jumia soft-close hinges 59-120 MAD. Basic hinges 20-40 MAD. Soft-close/amortisseur 59-120 MAD. Critical for labour-fixed-part-separate architecture: hardware cost is significant relative to likely labour.

evidence.raw_service_label: Coulisse tiroir (retail hardware unit price)
evidence.notes: Mr. Bricolage standard coulisse tiroir 19.90-25.90 MAD. Jumia range 54.99-99 MAD. Soft-close telescopic (Bricop/Cledor brand) 20+ MAD. Runners typically sold in pairs. Important for drawer runner replacement labour-part-separate model.

evidence.raw_service_label: Labour proportion in custom menuiserie projects
evidence.notes: allo-maison.ma states: sur un ouvrage correct, la main-d'œuvre représente 40 à 50% du total. Important for artisan economic modelling and detecting suspiciously low-priced quotes.

evidence.raw_service_label: MDF 18mm premier choix — m²
evidence.notes: Single market observation. Useful for material cost modelling in fabrication economics.

evidence.raw_service_label: Bibliothèque sur mesure — par mètre linéaire
evidence.notes: Range varies by depth, shelf thickness, and presence of lower doors. No further scope decomposition available.

evidence.raw_service_label: Geographic variation — city adjustment factor
evidence.notes: Observed city-level range differences from allo-maison.ma network: Casablanca/Rabat 2,500-6,000 MAD/ml. Marrakech/Tanger slightly below. Fès 2,000-4,800 MAD/ml (lowest observed). lechantier.ma BTP labour: Marrakech/Tanger = same as Casa; Agadir/Fès/Meknès -5 to -10%; Oujda/Tétouan -10 to -15%; smaller cities -15 to -25%. Research conclusion: city differences exist but are within normal market variance. No separate city multipliers warranted for estimator V1.

evidence.raw_service_label: Petite réparation placard / tiroir / meuble — platform listing
evidence.exclusion_reason: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE — platform confirms service exists but does not publish fixed prices. Used only to confirm service demand.
evidence.notes: AllohRayfi confirms small menuiserie repairs are offered (réparation porte de placard, tiroir, meuble). Pricing not published — quote-per-case basis. Confirms service category viability but insufficient for price anchor.

evidence.raw_service_label: Weekend / night / urgency labour premium — BTP
evidence.exclusion_reason: NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_MENUISERIE — BTP general data. AllohRayfi states same price evenings/weekends for petits travaux. Urgency premium is general BTP context (15-30%).
evidence.notes: BTP general: Sunday +50-100%, night +50%, urgency chantier +15-30%. AllohRayfi (petits travaux) explicitly states same price evening/weekend. Menuiserie repair context likely aligns with AllohRayfi policy. All modifiers remain null per research policy.
